overview:
①今日最要处理：rConfig（CVE-2026-124079）同 Babelfish for PostgreSQL（CVE-2026-119923）两个 CVSS 9.8 嘅未认证／堆溢出漏洞都命中你 data 栈嘅核心包，要先确认受影响版本（rConfig < 8.2.19／Pro < 8.4.1、Babelfish 1.0–5.4 各系列）同升级路径；另外 otterdog webapp（CVE-2026-123870，CVSS 9.5）用 eval() 处理 webhook JSON，若 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET 配置有缺口即系可被攻击，用到就要即时检。

②其余趋势：数据层同 Python 生态连环出事——Pillow TIFF 编码参数不符（≤12.3.0，8.3）、Python hashlib FIPS 模式算法强制失效（3.1x，8.2）、CockroachDB Postgres 用户权限提升（7.1），加上 Debian/Ubuntu 内核安全更新同「sshole」OpenSSH+musl 密码认证绕过，显示供应链与基础组件持续被集中爆。

③风险提示：未认证反序列化同认证绕过类漏洞往往几日内出在野利用，升级前至少要做临时缓解（WAF/关对外端口/收紧 webhook secret），唔好等补丁窗口。

sideline.title: See the agents, set the terms: New visibility and control for personal agents
sideline.summary: Personal AI agents have changed how users interact with the web, blurring the lines between automated and human traffic. Learn how Cloudflare gives site owners visibility and control to manage personal agent access.

sideline.title: Localizing compliance at scale: Achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
sideline.summary: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.

sideline.title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available

sideline.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants

sideline.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
sideline.summary: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer.

sideline.title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
